title: The Edge Case Database — Aggregation Over an Empty Array
body: Public edition. Public knowledge, fact-checked reference. Edge case: Aggregation Over an Empty Array. Domain: databases. Category: input boundary. Severity: high Trigger: An analytics query (average, min, max) runs over a category with zero records.
